\u27e6CODE1\u27e7: ["```python title=\"caching_capability.py\"", "from pydantic_ai import Agent", "from pydantic_ai.capabilities import Caching", "", "agent = Agent('anthropic:claude-opus-5-5', capabilities=[Caching()])", "```"]
\u27e6CODE2\u27e7: ["```python title=\"caching_stable_prefix.py\"", "from pydantic_ai import Agent", "from pydantic_ai.capabilities import Caching", "", "handbook = '...'  # a long document, well above the provider's minimum cacheable length", "", "agent = Agent(", "    'anthropic:claude-opus-5-5',", "    instructions=f'Answer questions about this employee handbook:\\n\\n{handbook}',", "    capabilities=[Caching(messages=False)],", ")", "", "# Two unrelated one-off questions: the second reads the handbook from the cache.", "agent.run_sync('Can I expense a home office chair?')", "agent.run_sync('Is remote work allowed on Fridays?')", "```"]
\u27e6CODE3\u27e7: ["```python title=\"unified_cache_stable_prefix.py\"", "from pydantic_ai import Agent", "", "agent = Agent(", "    'anthropic:claude-opus-5-5',", "    model_settings={'cache': {'retention': '1h', 'messages': False}},", ")", "```"]
\u27e6CODE4\u27e7: ["```python title=\"caching_check.py\"", "from pydantic_ai import Agent", "from pydantic_ai.capabilities import Caching", "", "handbook = '...'  # a long document, well above the provider's minimum cacheable length", "", "agent = Agent(", "    'anthropic:claude-opus-5-5',", "    instructions=f'Answer questions about this employee handbook:\\n\\n{handbook}',", "    capabilities=[Caching()],", ")", "", "first = agent.run_sync('How many vacation days do new employees get?')", "second = agent.run_sync('And after five years?', message_history=first.all_messages())", "", "written = first.response.usage.cache_write_tokens  # the handbook and the first question", "read = second.response.usage.cache_read_tokens  # what the first request wrote", "```"]
